statement: The architecture contract portfolio candidate contains the complete exact path union for Raft snapshot recovery, supported scale certification, feasibility-qualified placement balance, topology convergence SLOs, keyed Cell routing, generic Cell continuity, non-request invocation, their existing-owner integrations, and documentation truth, with no successor capability falsely reported as implemented.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The change artifact must include every new and modified roadmap, architecture, epic, and spec path in the portfolio; generated Quest bookkeeping remains separately owned.
